units.source_text: 东厅女公子年事既长，知情达理，举凡所见所闻，无不心领神会。

en.t: As the young lady of the eastern wing grew older, she became sensible and understanding, and grasped the meaning of everything she saw and heard.

units.source_text: 然而对于婚嫁的终身大事，则绝不考虑。

en.t: Yet she gave no thought at all to the lifelong matter of marriage.

units.source_text: 世间的男子，想必都有趋炎附势之心，对于有父亲的女儿，用尽心计强欲求婚，所以那两位女公子家里非常繁华热闹。

en.t: Men in the world must all have a desire to attach themselves to power, for they used every scheme to press their suits upon daughters who still had a father, and so the homes of those two young ladies were extremely lively and crowded.

units.source_text: 而这位东厅女公子这里呢，门庭寂寂，常常空闭深锁。

en.t: But around this young lady of the eastern wing, the gate and courtyard were silent, often shut up and locked tight.

units.source_text: 匂皇子传闻此种情状，认为这女公子正是适当的对象，便仔细考虑，设法向她求爱。

en.t: When Prince Niou heard of these circumstances, he thought this young lady was exactly the right person, and after careful consideration he sought ways to court her.

units.source_text: 他常常把小公子拉在身边，悄悄地叫他送信给东厅女公子。

en.t: He often drew the young gentleman to his side and quietly had him carry letters to the young lady of the eastern wing.

units.source_text: 但大纳言一心想把二女公子嫁给匂皇子，常在窥察匂皇子的意向，满望他动了念头前来求婚。

en.t: But the Dainagon was intent on marrying his second daughter to Prince Niou, and was constantly watching the prince's intentions, fully hoping he would take it into his head to come and propose.

units.source_text: 真木柱夫人见此情状，觉得可怜，说道：“大纳言弄错了。

en.t: Lady Makibashira saw this and felt sorry for him, saying, "The Dainagon is mistaken.

units.source_text: 他对二女公子毫无意思，你多费口舌，全是徒劳。”

en.t: He has no interest at all in the second young lady; however much you talk, it is all in vain."

units.source_text: 东厅女公子只字也不回复匂皇子。

en.t: The young lady of the eastern wing did not send Prince Niou even a single word in reply.

units.source_text: 匂皇子越发不肯认输，只管追求不舍。

en.t: Prince Niou became even less willing to admit defeat and simply kept pursuing her without giving up.

units.source_text: 真木柱夫人常常想道：“有何不可呢？

en.t: Lady Makibashira often thought, "What would be wrong with it?

units.source_text: 我看看匂皇子的人品，很希望他当我的女婿。

en.t: When I look at Prince Niou's character and bearing, I very much hope he will become my son-in-law.
I expect the future would be very happy."

units.source_text: 但东厅女公子认为：匂皇子是个非常贪色的人，私通的女子甚多。

en.t: But the young lady of the eastern wing thought that Prince Niou was an extremely amorous man, with many women with whom he had private affairs.

units.source_text: 对八亲王家的女公子，爱情也很深，常常远赴宇治和她相会。

en.t: He also felt deep affection for the young lady of Prince Hachi's house, and often traveled far to Uji to meet her.

units.source_text: 如此东钻西营，其心甚不可靠，决不可轻易允许。

en.t: Since he busied himself here and there in this way, his heart was utterly unreliable, and she could never lightly accept him.

units.source_text: 因此真心地拒绝他的求爱。

en.t: For that reason, she sincerely rejected his courtship.

units.source_text: 但真木柱夫人觉得很对不起他，有时不惜越俎代谋，偷偷地代女儿写回信给他。

en.t: But Lady Makibashira felt very sorry toward him, and sometimes even overstepped her place by secretly writing replies to him on her daughter's behalf.
